info.name: MetroMatrix — Chunk 3 (Healthcare)
info.description:
Discover → book (idempotent, real slots, shared record) → reschedule/cancel → doctor visit (check-in, notes, prescription, complete) → PHI isolation → prescription + review → admin.

Needs: migrated DB, `npm run seed:superadmin`, `npm run seed:health` (SEED_DEMO_PASSWORD), Mailpit. Run with `npm run postman:health` (passes adminPassword and demoPassword from env; never stored here). No file is uploaded: the record URL is built inside the signed folder.

pm.test('12 specialties, common conditions, featured doctors', () => { pm.expect(d.specialties).to.have.length(12); pm.expect(d.commonConditions.length).to.be.above(5); pm.expect(d.featuredDoctors.length).to.be.above(0); });
pm.test('Urdu name and a doctor count', () => { pm.expect(derm.nameUr).to.eql('ماہر امراض جلد'); pm.expect(derm.doctorCount).to.be.above(0); });
pm.test('Acne, mapped to Dermatologist first', () => { const acne = d.find((c) => c.slug === 'acne'); pm.expect(acne.specialties[0].slug).to.eql('dermatologist'); });
pm.test('Dermatologists in Lahore, earliest first → 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('ordered by next available', () => pm.expect(t).to.eql([...t].sort((a, b) => a - b)));
pm.test('labels made by the server in PKT', () => d.items.filter((c) => c.nextAvailable).forEach((c) => pm.expect(c.nextAvailable.at).to.match(/\+05:00$/)));
pm.test('video doctors only, all female', () => d.items.forEach((c) => { pm.expect(c.offersVideo).to.be.true; pm.expect(c.gender).to.eql('female'); }));
pm.test('no account numbers on a public profile', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(d)).to.not.match(/PK\d{2}[A-Z]{4}\d{16}/));
pm.test('same specialty, not the doctor', () => d.forEach((c) => { pm.expect(c.specialty.slug).to.eql('dermatologist'); pm.expect(c.id).to.not.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('doctorId')); }));
pm.test('Slots at the clinic (7 days) → 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

request.description: Postman never uploads a file. It builds a URL inside the signed folder, which is all the API checks.

exec: pm.test('Records: sign a private upload → 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Records: add a lab report → 201', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
pm.test('a short-lived download link for the owner', () => pm.expect(d.files[0].downloadUrl).to.include('/download?'));
pm.test('HC- code, booked, pay at clinic', () => { pm.expect(d.code).to.match(/^HC-[A-Z2-9]{6}$/); pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('booked'); pm.expect(d.payment.method).to.eql('pay_at_clinic'); });
pm.test('the fee comes from the location, never the client', () => pm.expect(d.fee).to.be.above(1));
pm.test('the record is shared with this visit', () => pm.expect(d.sharedRecords.map((r) => r.id)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('recordId')));
pm.test('Booking replay (same key → same appointment) → 201', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));

exec: pm.test('A time off the grid → SLOT_INVALID → 400', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));

item.name: The same slot for the child → SLOT_TAKEN + alternatives

exec: pm.test('The same slot for the child → SLOT_TAKEN + alternatives → 409', () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));
pm.test('snapshot of the child', () => { pm.expect(d.patient.name).to.eql('Zara Patient'); pm.expect(d.patient.relation).to.eql('child'); });

pm.test('timeline and actions from the server', () => { pm.expect(d.events[0].to).to.eql('booked'); pm.expect(d.can.cancel).to.be.true; pm.expect(d.can.reschedule).to.be.true; pm.expect(d.can.review).to.be.false; });
pm.test('a new appointment linked to the old one', () => { pm.expect(d.code).to.not.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('childCode')); pm.expect(d.rescheduledFromId).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('cancelled by the patient, not late', () => { pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('cancelled'); pm.expect(d.cancelledBy).to.eql('patient'); pm.expect(d.lateCancel).to.be.false; });

pm.test('Symptom checker: red flag (Roman Urdu) → 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('not an emergency; a specialty and areas to discuss', () => { pm.expect(d.emergency).to.be.false; pm.expect(d.specialty.slug).to.eql('dermatologist'); pm.expect(d.areasToDiscuss).to.be.an('array'); });
